reason: The company achieved record sales of Rs 600 crore in just 60 hours for its Vyana project, signaling strong demand and cash flow acceleration in the Pune real estate market.
why_now: The announcement was made via official exchange filing on September 10, 2026.
source_headlines: Kolte - Patil Developers Limited: Kolte - Patil Developers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 10, 2026, titled "Kolte-Patil Developers Marks its Strongest-ever Launch Performance with Sales of over Rs. 600 crore in 60 hours at Vyana at The Reserve , Pune".
